description: This Java class defines the GeoZone entity for the sales management system, including its properties, relationships to descriptions and countries, and JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Entity class representing a geographic zone, including identifiers, name, code, and associations with countries and descriptions.

methods.name: GeoZone
methods.description: Default constructor for the GeoZone entity.

methods.description: Retrieves the name of the GeoZone.
